decisions.reason: As a low-pressure injection pump close to the core portfolio and still prominently supported, it is a well-fitting line extension that a medium-sized German machinery firm would normally continue to back.

The low-pressure material transfer pump is a multi-model product line in the firm's core processing equipment business, so the sunk development effort and broad application fit make withdrawal unlikely.

Fire protection flow monitoring is somewhat more adjacent than the pump products, but it supports the firm's move toward more integrated and future-oriented customer solutions and is therefore still worth retaining.

The hydraulic two-component spraying system is close to the established offer and aligns with the firm's customization and application-engineering strengths, although as the newest launch it still carries somewhat higher early-market uncertainty.
